ambiguities: Prices are quoted per 'SET (2 PCS)' while the RFQ asks for a per-single-unit price basis — confirm whether USD 54/108/148 is per set or per piece.
Quantities are stated in sets (20/12/10); confirm these equate to the 40/24/20 nos required.
No Incoterm or freight basis is stated anywhere (no EXW/FOB/CIF), so landed cost from Singapore is unknown.
Lead time '4 wks' has no stated basis (ex-works readiness vs delivered to India) and may not meet the 2026-11-18 need-by once shipping is added.
Payment is LC at sight, not a credit period in days from invoice as requested; no early-payment discount offered.
